defect: Owner report: the iOS medium widget truncated sentences early, the last line ending in an ellipsis too soon.
causes: The line limit was Int(height / 20). n lines of 14-point text on a 20-point rhythm take 20n minus one line's spacing (about 3.3 points), so a 77 to 79 point text area (155 and 157 point medium widgets with the app name shown) was limited to 3 lines with room for 4.
Separately, a 140-character sentence (the prompt's budget including the prefix) needs a fifth 14-point line in the 227-point column of a 338 x 158 widget with the app name shown, where only 4 fit.
fix: lines = Int((height + spacing) / 20); a ViewThatFits tries the sentence at 14, 13.5, 13 and 12.5 points, each with line spacing that keeps the 20-point rhythm, and only the smallest is line-limited and truncated.
